objective: Verify remediation of the initial CANVAS plus U1/PAXX review findings without expanding the milestone.

remediation.change: Added a 41-byte golden encoder vector and a real pinned OpenRFID factory-vector decoder test covering header, manufacturer marker, material/subtype, RGBA, nozzle range, diameter, and weight offsets.

remediation.finding: Data outside pages 16-31 could leave a competing payload
remediation.change: CANVAS one-tag writes now require every inspected user-area byte outside pages 16-31 to be zero. Non-zero data is rejected and preserved; it is never erased implicitly. Discovery also refuses to describe such a tag as a one-format CANVAS tag.

remediation.finding: Compatibility claims were insufficiently bounded without hardware acceptance
remediation.change: Resolver and UI now say implementation-compatible and prominently state that physical CANVAS and U1 reader acceptance remains pending and experimental.

remediation.finding: Dynamic-lock validation omitted other lock bits
remediation.evidence: NXP NTAG213/215/216 data sheet dynamic-lock mapping assigns byte 0 bit 0 to pages 16-31 and byte 2 bit 0 to the corresponding block-lock. Other bits govern later ranges. Tests now prove later-range bits do not falsely reject pages 16-31. AUTH0 <= 31 is rejected.

remediation.finding: Interrupted raw writes need a recovery path
remediation.change: The durable write state already forbids automatic retry and requires a same-UID read-only reconciliation. The CANVAS interruption message now explicitly says pages 16-31 may be partially modified.

remediation.finding: Unsupported profile fields were not clear
remediation.evidence: The encoder fails closed for unrepresentable brand/material and the existing encoded preview enumerates every omitted local field before arming a write.

known_limits: No physical NTAG215, CANVAS, or U1/PAXX acceptance was performed.
PAXX documents unreliable factory Elegoo tag placement on U1.
The pre-existing dirty working tree was preserved; the exact dirty snapshot was validated remotely.
review_questions: Do the golden vectors prove alignment with the pinned OpenRFID Elegoo processor?
Does the one-format exclusivity check prevent a competing payload without destructive cleanup?
Are the remaining compatibility statements properly bounded?
Are any initial HIGH findings still materially open?
sanitization: No credentials, tokens, keys, private network addresses, NFC UIDs, user data, device serials, photos, or account data are included.
